basis: Genuine Avid regenerated MDB descriptor properties retained by 8 October specimen probe; no authored 32-byte graph is included. Property metadata byte order is little endian. Labels are converted from retained AUID fields to UL octet order. Only existing verified legacy mapping pairs included.
limits: All 61 evidenced descriptor owners have 12-byte MobIDs; authored identity-width tests are not included and do not prove a genuine 32-byte-owner/JFIF format.
Exact compatible labels are used; no UL-prefix wildcard or unverified DV100 mapping is admitted.
Source vocabulary registrations establish names/type meaning; genuine Avid descriptor pairs corroborate compatibility. OMF specifications do not prescribe MediaMuster display priority.
typeBoundary: Compression must be an omfi:String containing exactly a 4-character code, optionally followed by NUL. The original toolkit omfsWriteString writes strlen+1 for strings of length 4 or greater; omfsReadString also accepts an unterminated recorded string and terminates it at the actual value end. ResolutionID must be a named 32-bit integer property (omfi:Long, omfi:Int32 or omfi:UInt32) with 4 bytes. Other types remain raw evidence.
